text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
——Wait… R-Really…? I was wondering why I 
kept getting notifications… It's going 
viral?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
It's not just Love-chan's fans like 
normal… It broke containment to a 
completely different audience…

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: …This piece…

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
It's full of the deep emotion I felt when 
I first saw Love-chan running…

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
I could feel my chest burning hot—— Just 
thinking about it makes my heart race. 
It's my dearest memory.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
I tried to take that unforgettable moment, 
burning deep in the back of my mind, and 
put it on the canvas… And now it's going 
viral…

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: ? …A DM? W-Who could it be?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It's amazing, Maru-chan! You have people 
all over the world looking at your art!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: Yeah…! I never imagined this would happen…

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
It's still getting a lot of comments. 
Look——

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Let me see… "why am i crying" "Ah, youth" 
"This art makes me want to keep on going"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
No matter how the viewer interprets this 
painting, it brings out a strong emotional 
reaction. It's so lovely…

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: …Yeah. …So, um, also…

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: … Look at this!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
! Wow! An invitation to be part of an art 
exhibition? And they want the two of us to 
do it as a pair…!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, it's a show where only a 
select few amateurs chosen by pros get to 
exhibit their work. I-It's a super special 
honor…!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
A-And they say they want us to make a new 
piece for the exhibition, too…!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Finally, your talent's being recognized… 
It makes me so happy. We'd better work 
together to make a masterpiece!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "We gladly accept…" …There. And send…

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
…Hehe. I can't believe I get to do this as 
a pair with her.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
I- I wonder what we should make. I'll need 
to ask Love-chan what her ideas are… …Hm?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: … …More comments?

"Can't wait to see the next one!" "i want 
merch of this～" "followed!" "I'm waiting 
for your next work."

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
Whoa… W-We'd better work hard a-and make 
something great for them…!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! If you've got the time, I'd 
love if you came to see!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! If you've got the time, I'd 
love if you came to see!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Love-chan and Maru-chan are gonna make 
the best art ever!"

I happened to run into Marche Lorraine and 
Loves Only You, and overheard that they'd 
been invited to an exhibition.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Art" is a such a simple word, but there's 
so many things it can be… It's hard to 
wrap my head around all the different 
mediums.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I spent all day yesterday thinking about 
it, but I can't seem to settle on one 
idea.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I can pin ideas down for streaming just 
fine, but I guess that doesn't exactly 
carry over to art.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
! "That just means you have a vivid 
imagination. The ideas just can't stop 
coming, and it's too much, right? I've 
been there!"

After seeing Loves Only You's worried 
expression, Marche Lorraine's own 
expression took on an apologetic color. 
What should I say——
choice_data_list: Marche Lorraine can handle it, right?
Trust her to do it if you can't.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "Huh!?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're right! I've got the most 
capable partner in the world for this 
project!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "Huh?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're right. We're not in this 
alone, we're a team! I believe in you, 
Maru-chan!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "! Love-chan is counting me…"

Marche Lorraine was capable of making art 
that drew even pros' attention. It would 
be a good idea to let her lead the 
project.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Though obviously, I'm not just going to 
dump all the work on you. I think I've got 
what it takes, so anything you need me to 
do, I'll give it 100%!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Still, though… I really want to see what 
you come up with.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I want to help you make the piece YOU want 
to make. …Is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: A- "Are you sure?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I'm sure.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: ! Oh…

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
… "Just leave it to me! I'm gonna come up 
with the best idea ever!"

Marche Lorraine heartily accepted Loves 
Only You's request with her eyes burning 
bright.
